Watchful Crown.name: Watchful Crown
Watchful Crown.description: The user buds a working eye and ear at the tip of every extra limb and spreads them around a room, a corner or a wall of rubble. Until the end of the scene the user sees and hears in every direction at once: nobody can surprise or flank them or a person they hold, the first attack each turn from behind or above is blocked by a limb, and budded mouths let them talk to several trapped people at once. A blow to any bud hurts the user and blinds that limb until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
